statements.impact_statement: Scout compares each perl-* subpackage's own release (e.g. perl-base 2.27-477.amzn2023.0.11) against the perl source-package fix version (5.32.1-477.amzn2023.0.4), not against the matching release suffix. The installed release (.0.11) is already newer than the fix (.0.4); the fixed code is present. See SECURITY.md 'perl - false positives'.
Same false positive as CVE-2023-31484, compared against fix version 5.32.1-477.amzn2023.0.5 instead of .0.4. The installed release (.0.11) is already newer. See SECURITY.md 'perl - false positives'.
